title: Annual policy review (in-service)
summary: An in-service course structure for law enforcement agencies, security companies and other organizations that review critical policies every year: use of force, de-escalation, legal updates and reporting duties, each closing with the member's acknowledgment. Structure only; add your agency's policies and set the hours your training standard requires.
tags: in-service, policy review, law enforcement, security, starter
overview: A structure written by Resgrid. It contains no policy text and no legal advice: add your agency's current policies, this year's legal updates and your instructors' material before you publish the course. Record the hours against the in-service category your training standard uses.

lessons.title: Policy review
lessons.html:
Review your agency's use-of-force policy in full, and what changed since last year.

Attach or paste the current policy, and link the protocol members acknowledge.

lessons.title: De-escalation
lessons.html:
Review the de-escalation expectations in your policy with scenarios drawn from your own calls.

Add your scenarios and instructor notes.

lessons.title: This year's legal updates
lessons.html: Add the court decisions, legislation and policy changes your legal adviser selected for this year.

lessons.title: Reporting duties
lessons.html: Review what members must report, to whom and how quickly: force used, injuries, complaints and misconduct they witness.
